long_biography.plain_text:
Yuri Milner was born in Moscow in 1961 and trained in theoretical physics at Moscow State University before moving into business. After working at the World Bank, he founded Mail.ru Group in 1999 and took it public in 2010. He founded DST Global in 2009 to make global internet investments; its portfolio has included Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Airbnb, Spotify and Alibaba.

Forbes identifies Milner's self-made fortune with technology investments and lists his citizenship as Israel. He has been an Israeli citizen since 1999 and completed the process of renouncing Russian citizenship in 2022. Alongside investing, Milner and his wife Julia have supported science through the Breakthrough Prizes. He also launched Breakthrough Listen with Stephen Hawking in 2015 and Breakthrough Starshot in 2016, programmes aimed respectively at searching for technological civilizations and developing technology for uncrewed interstellar travel.

uncertainties: The source record gives Russian as Milner's nationality, but current Forbes and first-party evidence list him as an Israeli citizen and state that he completed renunciation of Russian citizenship in 2022. Israeli is therefore proposed as a correction rather than as a secondary nationality.

First-party biographies use Yuri Milner without a patronymic. Wikipedia gives both Borisovich and Bentsionovich as variants, and the existing biography awkwardly combines them. Because no authoritative current source resolved which website middle-name value should be preferred, middle_names remains blank.

The official site confirms Moscow and 1961 but not the day and month. Forbes' contemporary 2011 profile states that he would turn 50 on 11 November 2011, and the exact-match Wikipedia profile corroborates 11 November 1961; the date proposals are therefore very-high but not 100 confidence.
No second current nationality was established after the Russian-citizenship renunciation. United States residence and property ownership were not treated as evidence of United States citizenship.

The existing LinkedIn URL uses a legacy profile path, while Milner's official site links to https://www.linkedin.com/in/yuri-milner. The stored link was not duplicated or changed because both paths may resolve to the same account and social updates are outside the detail-correction structure.

The source record links Milner to the 116.15-metre Multiverse from June 2019 and to the 107.42-metre Andromeda from October 2017. SuperYachtFan reports Milner as Multiverse's owner but explicitly frames that attribution as something it was told; BOAT International confirms the vessel identity and original commissioning by Graeme Hart without naming Milner as the current owner. The yacht relationship therefore supports only cautious disambiguation and was omitted from the biographies.

Finance & Investments is used rather than Technology because the evidenced wealth mechanism is the allocation of investment capital through DST Global, even though the underlying portfolio is technology-focused. Investor is used rather than Founder because his principal relationship to the portfolio companies and wealth-producing assets is investment allocation through the platform he founded.
Title, suffix and secondary residence are optional fields and were not inferred. Blank death, internal-note and unknown-name fields remain inapplicable or system-managed.
